in_sanskrit.name: प्रजनन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The act of procreation or creation; the power to generate or produce offspring

in_marathi.name: Prajanan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prajanan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu tradition, Prajanan refers to the one who creates or gives birth, symbolizing divine creation.

in_bengali.name: Prajanan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ The Creator
in_bengali.long_meaning: Prajanan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu tradition, Prajanan refers to the one who creates or gives birth, symbolizing divine creation.
